title: A Strange Dream
description: Practise past tenses and linking words, then write a short story about a dream.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🌙 Last night I ___ a strange dream.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: I ___ flying over the town when I saw a giant bird.
exercises.explanation: Use was with I in the past continuous.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Tom opened a big door behind the tree.
Behind the tree Tom opened a big door.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I was scared ___ the forest was very dark.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Then a fish swimmed up to me.
answers: Then a fish swam up to me.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.explanation: Use couldn't + base verb for something not possible in the past.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: While I ___ in the garden, it began to snow.
exercises.explanation: Use the past continuous for a longer action: was walking.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: I met a rabbit ___ wore a red hat.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" or "that" for a talking animal.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We ran and hid in the cave.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I woke up ___ I heard my alarm.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I didn't saw my mum in the dream.
answers: I didn't see my mum in the dream.
exercises.explanation: After "didn't" use the base verb: see.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Maybe the dream was about my exam. It ___ be true.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: I was frightened of the big dog.
answers: I was afraid of the big dog.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Suddenly, the floor ___ and I fell down. (disappear)

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: The giant walked ___ across the field.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: In my dream, my cat were very big.
answers: In my dream, my cat was very big.
exercises.explanation: Use "was" with one thing: my cat was.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: I woke up. After that I felt happy.
answers: After I woke up, I felt happy.
I felt happy after I woke up.
exercises.explanation: Use "after" to join the two events.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: I ___ never had such a funny dream before.

task.prompt: Write a story called "A Strange Dream". Say what you dreamed about.
task.modelAnswer: Last night I dreamed that I was flying over my school. Suddenly, I saw a big yellow rabbit who was sitting on a cloud. It said, "Come with me!" I felt very happy, but a little afraid. We flew to a castle made of ice cream. Then my alarm rang and I woke up. I was hungry!
